description: Small databases and the problems validation must report for them. A case starts from 'master'; a file of the case replaces the file of the same path (text null: the file is removed). 'file' is the index of the file in 'files'. Generated by tests/make_vectors.py; the expectations are written by hand there. 'canonical': a file's text and its canonical text (members in schema order, unknown members last, strings trimmed, empty optional members dropped, numbers as written).
